name: Boaz
summary: A wealthy man of Bethlehem, a relative of Naomi's husband, who was kind to Ruth in his barley field. He bought back the family land and married her, and their son Obed was the grandfather of David.

key_moments.title: Shows Kindness to Ruth in His Field
key_moments.description: Boaz came from Bethlehem and noticed Ruth gleaning in his field. He told her to stay close to his maidens, gave her bread at mealtime, and had his young men drop handfuls of grain for her.

key_moments.title: Woken at Midnight
key_moments.description: Boaz woke in the night to find Ruth lying at his feet. He promised to do all she asked as a near kinsman, if a closer relative would not, and sent her home with six measures of barley.

key_moments.title: Redeeming at the Gate
key_moments.description: At the city gate, the closer relative gave up his right and took off his shoe. Boaz bought all that had been Elimelech's, married Ruth, and the LORD gave them a son.
